Questions people ask before buying

The questions Google shows for this product, answered from what 99 creators actually said and showed in their stories.

Is the SPF 50 in a BB cream enough on its own?

Creators treat it as their everyday sun protection: 189 of the 190 stories we read mention the SPF, and most wear it as the only base on city days. For a full day in strong sun the usual rule still applies: apply a generous layer and reapply, or add a dedicated sunscreen underneath.

BB cream or foundation, which one is this?

It sits between the two. 107 of 190 stories describe natural, buildable coverage that evens out the skin without the mask effect of a foundation. Creators call it the base they wear instead of foundation on normal days, and several say they did not pack a foundation for holidays.

Which shade should I pick?

The Polish range has five shades: 0.5 Porcelain, 01 Ivory, 02 Vanilla, 03 Nude and 04 Beige. In the stories where creators name their shade, 04 Beige comes up most, followed by 02 Vanilla. It is sold in drugstores, so testing on the hand in store is easy.

Is it good for oily or combination skin?

Creators do not single out one skin type: "all skin types" and "everyday wear" are the two most common descriptions. The finish is satin rather than matte, so people with very oily skin pair it with a setting mist or a light powder, which is the routine most of the stories show.

Does it really cover imperfections?

Yes for redness, uneven tone and small spots, which is what the stories show on bare skin. It is not a full-coverage product: nobody in 190 stories claims it hides acne scars or heavy discolouration, and that is the one thing creators consistently do not promise.

Is Eveline a brand worth trusting?

On the Metapic creator network, Eveline is the most recommended beauty brand of 2026: this BB cream is the most posted of 279 beauty products, and seven other Eveline products rank in the top ten by creators. The brand has been made in Poland since 1983 and sells through Rossmann, Hebe, Douglas and its own shop.
